1. (Currently amended) A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, __wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide.__

2. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about __5__-35 weight percent of the total composition.

3. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is __selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide and is__ provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours.

4. (Previously presented) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition.

5. (Previously presented) The gas generator of claim 4 wherein said extrusion aid is selected from graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof.

6. (Previously presented) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate.

7. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, __and wherein said desiccant is zeolite.__

8. (Currently amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is DL-tartaric acid, __and wherein said desiccant is zeolite.__

9. (Original) A gas generating system comprising: a gas generator comprising a composition, said composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and said composition further containing a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition.

10. (Original) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition.

11. (Original) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition.

12. (Original) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said system is a vehicle occupant protection system.

13. (Currently amended) A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight-percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition, __wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide.__

14. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, __and wherein said desiccant is zeolite.__

15. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 13 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate.

16. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, [[strikethrough]]zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide[[/strikethrough]] __and clay, and calcium oxide.__

17. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is zeolite.

18. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is __physically separated from and in vapor communication with__ said composition __and is__ selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours.
